title: Lanthanide-containing clusters for catalytic water splitting and CO2 conversion
claim: A porous Eu2 cluster MOF with Ru(phen)3-type ligands selectively photoreduces CO2 to formate through ligand-to-cluster electron transfer and a two-electron Eu(II)–H2–Eu(II) active site.
explanation: Ultrafast transient absorption and fluorescence support electron transfer from the photosensitizer to {Eu(III)}. DFT and in situ EPR indicate that the dinuclear europium site, after reduction, participates in two-electron CO2 reduction. The formate rate is 321.9 μmol h−1 mmolMOF−1, and crystallinity plus low Eu leaching support stability.
scope: Heterogeneous Eu–Ru(phen)3 MOFs for visible-light CO2 reduction to HCOO−.
caveats: The review later notes that LnCC photoreduction products demonstrated so far remain the two-electron products CO and HCOOH.
